strips.title: A cold morning with a tire-pressure light — in real life

panels.head: 7 a.m. — the light
panels.text: The TPMS light comes on after the first cold night. It means a tire is about 25% under the door-jamb number.

panels.head: 7:05 — set the number
panels.text: Read the placard on the door edge, set that psi on the pump, press go. It stops by itself.

panels.head: 7:10 — check with a gauge
panels.text: Tests found no gauge perfectly accurate. A $10 handheld gauge settles it.

panels.head: Next month — top up
panels.text: Check tires cold, once a month. A few psi is a one-minute job instead of a gas-station stop.
